subject: Deployment not working - Old Python installation on Shinyapps.io

messages.author: 827119596f1ebf35
messages.subject: Deployment not working - Old Python installation on Shinyapps.io
parts:
When I deploy my until recently working shinyapps.io app I now get the following error:


Found existing installation: six 1.5.2
Cannot uninstall 'six'. It is a distutils installed project and thus we cannot accurately determine which files belong to it which would lead to only a partial uninstall.


It seems that the python installation on the shinyapps.io servers is outdated or incorrect. This issue has already been reported multiple times over the last month...
Especially for paying users, this is pretty much unacceptable, since our clients' apps may not be working, or we may simply be paying for a service that is unavailable.

I know that shinyapps.io is busy, but such grave problems should be resolved within an overseeable amount of time...
I would commend shinyapps.io for looking into this.
Thank you.
